description: Czech company by IČO (00177041 or VAT CZ00177041) or name, live from ARES, the Czech Ministry of Finance's register of economic subjects: name, legal form, status, founding and dissolution dates, commercial-register, VAT and insolvency-register records, industry codes, registered address. Use to verify a Czech customer or supplier. Register facts only, not a credit report. Example: ico=00177041. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
